assumptions: the solver is not key-local: U is the per-record enumeration plus the exact whole-mechanism combinations; couplings from partial (shard) ablations across records are not enumerated, so U is not a guaranteed upper bound

U.rule: U must exceed 1 - cap: otherwise no combination of the designed mechanisms can bring the average strictly below the cap; the solver is not composable, so U is no guaranteed bound: UNVERIFIED, which needs a written disposition (geometry.U), never BLOCK

dispositions.rule: an UNVERIFIED U (the solver is not composable) needs a written disposition, never a BLOCK
